title: Clark segment of North-South Commuter Railway to be operational by 2029

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Commuters can look forward to a shorter travel time from Makati City to Clark International Airport as the Clark station of the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) is expected to be operational by 2029, Transportion Secretary Vince Dizon said on Monday. “Lampas ng kaunti sa term ng pangulo pero ang importante, matatapos tayo na by 2029 from Makati hanggang dito sa Clark, tapos na,” Dizon said as he led the inspection of the NSCR project segment construction at the Clark Freeport Zone in Pampanga.
